failures.diagnosis: 258 of 259 tests pass. The single failure, tests/architecture/test_publication_boundary.py::test_private_keys_are_not_repository_files, asserts no private-key/PEM file exists among repository files. It names '.venv/lib/python3.11/site-packages/pip/_vendor/certifi/cacert.pem' - a file created by this Layer 1 harness running `ensurepip` into the repo-local gitignored .venv to repair a pip-less venv left by the session-deps hook. The repo's invariant is sound and the repo's own code is not implicated. Removal of the harness-added pip tree was attempted and denied by the operator permission gate, so the contamination persists in this workspace.

failures.diagnosis: `make ci` -> `make deps` -> `make hooks` runs the zizmor pre-commit hook, which fetches https://github.com/actions/checkout.git and receives HTTP 401 Unauthorized for git-upload-pack. This is an external-network/credential limitation of the sandbox, not a defect in l9-ci-sdk. The repo's own test suite was never reached, so this repo's health is undetermined rather than failing.
